body:
**`Test UI (9/16)` is red on this PR, and the cause is on `main`, not in this diff.** This PR changes only the root `.github/workflows/ci.yml` `type-check-ui` job. The failing test is `ui/scripts/__tests__/workflow-cache-save-bound.test.ts`: it asserts that `ui/.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml` defines `release:` and `lane:` jobs, and #25745 (2a61f08093) deleted that file.

The same shard is red on `main`: push run 40247794069 (90a34e2039) and schedule run 40247421544 (2a61f08093) both fail `Test UI` 3/16, 8/16 and 9/16.

- 3/16 is `ui/packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts` (ENOENT on `ui/.changeset/config.json`). #25852 fixes it.
- 8/16 is `ui/scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` (ENOENT on `ui/.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml`).
- 9/16 is the test above.

No open PR fixes 8/16 or 9/16 yet. #25852's own run (6015709368) is still red on both. I'm reporting them to the epic PM for a card. They are out of this card's scope, so this PR does not widen to cover them. `Test UI` is not in the required set. I'm not re-running the job, because the red reproduces deterministically on `main`.
